No vendor lock-in.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eZero-Config Start\u003c/strong\u003e — Single binary, embedded SQLite, no external dependencies. Running in under 30 seconds.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eFull Trace Capture\u003c/strong\u003e — Every request logged with model, tokens, latency, cost, and API key hash. Streaming is proxied in real time with minimal overhead.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eHTTP Analytics API\u003c/strong\u003e — Query traces plus usage, cost, model, key, latency, and error-rate analytics via stable JSON endpoints.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eReproducible Calls\u003c/strong\u003e — Trace metadata always captures model, tokens, latency, cost, and route context. Enable body capture for full payload-level replay.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003ePrivacy First\u003c/strong\u003e — Request/response body logging is off by default and opt-in. API keys are hashed, never stored in plain text.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003ePII Redaction\u003c/strong\u003e — Configurable redaction modes for storage and upstream traffic, with scoped policies per workspace or provider.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eOpenTelemetry and Prometheus\u003c/strong\u003e — Native OTLP HTTP export for distributed traces and 12 operational metrics. Prometheus scrape endpoint for existing monitoring stacks. Logs, traces, and metrics are correlated end-to-end: structured logs carry \u003ccode\u003etrace_id\u003c/code\u003e and \u003ccode\u003espan_id\u003c/code\u003e, and histogram exemplars link latency spikes directly to the request trace that caused them.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eBroad Compatibility\u003c/strong\u003e — Most tools that support OpenAI/Anthropic base URL configuration work via environment variables, with no plugins required.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003chr\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"markdown-heading\" dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003ch2 tabindex=\"-1\" class=\"heading-element\" dir=\"auto\"\u003eHow Auth Works\u003c/h2\u003e\u003ca id=\"user-content-how-auth-works\" class=\"anchor\" aria-label=\"Permalink: How Auth Works\" href=\"#how-auth-works\"\u003e\u003csvg data-component=\"Octicon\" class=\"octicon octicon-link\" viewBox=\"0 0 16 16\" version=\"1.1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\" aria-hidden=\"true\"\u003e\u003cpath d=\"m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z\"\u003e\u003c/path\u003e\u003c/svg\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eDefault mode:\u003c/strong\u003e your tools still hold the provider keys. <p dir="auto"><strong>Open-source AI gateway for tracing, cost visibility, and audit-ready logs — with minimal overhead.</strong></p>
<p dir="auto">OngoingAI Gateway runs in front of your AI providers so every request is <strong>visible, attributable, and reproducible</strong> — without changing your code. Works with OpenAI, Anthropic, and OpenAI-compatible APIs.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Why it exists</h3><a id="user-content-why-it-exists" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Why it exists" href="#why-it-exists"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">AI calls are production traffic, but most teams can't answer the questions that matter:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Which models are being used — and by what service, key, or workspace?</li>
<li>What did it cost per route, per team, or per environment?</li>
<li>What changed when latency spiked, errors started, or spend jumped?</li>
<li>Can we reproduce a request for debugging or audit?</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">OngoingAI Gateway gives you a <strong>provider-agnostic request log</strong> with <strong>privacy-first defaults</strong>: tokens, latency, cost, and key hashes are always captured; request/response bodies are opt-in.</p>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Features</h2><a id="user-content-features" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Features" href="#features"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Provider Agnostic</strong> — Works with OpenAI, Anthropic, and any OpenAI-compatible API. No vendor lock-in.</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Zero-Config Start</strong> — Single binary, embedded SQLite, no external dependencies. Running in under 30 seconds.</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Full Trace Capture</strong> — Every request logged with model, tokens, latency, cost, and API key hash. Streaming is proxied in real time with minimal overhead.</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>HTTP Analytics API</strong> — Query traces plus usage, cost, model, key, latency, and error-rate analytics via stable JSON endpoints.</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Reproducible Calls</strong> — Trace metadata always captures model, tokens, latency, cost, and route context. Enable body capture for full payload-level replay.</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Privacy First</strong> — Request/response body logging is off by default and opt-in. API keys are hashed, never stored in plain text.</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>PII Redaction</strong> — Configurable redaction modes for storage and upstream traffic, with scoped policies per workspace or provider.</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>OpenTelemetry and Prometheus</strong> — Native OTLP HTTP export for distributed traces and 12 operational metrics. Prometheus scrape endpoint for existing monitoring stacks. Logs, traces, and metrics are correlated end-to-end: structured logs carry <code>trace_id</code> and <code>span_id</code>, and histogram exemplars link latency spikes directly to the request trace that caused them.</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Broad Compatibility</strong> — Most tools that support OpenAI/Anthropic base URL configuration work via environment variables, with no plugins required.</p>
<hr>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">How Auth Works</h2><a id="user-content-how-auth-works" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: How Auth Works" href="#how-auth-works"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Default mode:</strong> your tools still hold the provider keys. OngoingAI Gateway forwards <code>OPENAI_API_KEY</code> / <code>ANTHROPIC_API_KEY</code> and stores only hashed key identifiers in traces.</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Team gateway keys (optional):</strong> Enable <code>auth.enabled</code> to require gateway authentication on proxy and analytics routes. Gateway tokens are passed via <code>X-OngoingAI-Gateway-Key</code> and are used only for gateway authorization (RBAC + tenant identity). Provider API keys are still supplied by the client and are never stored by OngoingAI.</p>
<p dir="auto">See <code>AUTHORIZATION.md</code> for the resource/action/scope policy and role-permission matrix.</p>
<hr>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Security & Privacy</h2><a id="user-content-security--privacy" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Security & Privacy" href="#security--privacy"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>API keys:</strong> Forwarded to the upstream provider, never stored. Only hashed identifiers are kept in traces.</li>
<li><strong>Request/response bodies:</strong> Off by default. Opt in with <code>capture_bodies: true</code> and cap size via <code>body_max_size</code>.</li>
<li><strong>Metadata:</strong> Always captured (model, tokens, latency, cost) regardless of body capture settings.</li>
<li><strong>Storage:</strong> SQLite file stored locally. Ensure appropriate file permissions on <code>data/ongoingai.db</code>.</li>
<li><strong>Gateway auth:</strong> Optional team/role-based key auth is available via config and should be enabled for shared/team deployments.</li>
</ul>
